findings.title: ACTION hover gradient ignores custom brand color
findings.problem: action-accent-hover now hardcodes linear-gradient(90deg,#672D92 0%,#5677C8 100%) instead of var(--backgroundImage-action-accent-hover), so the CSS variable computed by rules.ts §6 via deriveAlternateOklchLightness on primaryButtonBackground has no consumer in the dark theme.
findings.impact: In any deployment with an active custom appearance theme, hovering an ACTION-type button shows the wrong brand gradient; the computed hover color is silently discarded. bg-action-accent-hover is applied at Button.tsx:79 for ButtonType.ACTION.
findings.recommendation: Restore 'action-accent-hover': 'var(--backgroundImage-action-accent-hover)' in the dark-theme backgroundImage block of tailwind.config.ts. If a WCAG-compliant stop value is needed, update the oklch derivation in rules.ts §6 to produce the target color rather than hardcoding it in the Tailwind config.
